name: Sleet Storm

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

authored_intent: 20-foot-radius/40-foot-tall cylinder; Heavy Obscurement, extinguish exposed flames, Difficult Terrain; first entry on a turn or turn start DEX save or Prone and lose Concentration; no appearance or end-turn save.

rules.text: Until the spell ends, sleet falls in a 40-foot-tall, 20-foot-radius Cylinder centered on a point you choose within range.
The area is Heavily Obscured, and exposed flames in the area are doused.
Ground in the Cylinder is Difficult Terrain.
When a creature enters the Cylinder for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or have the Prone condition and lose Concentration.
